run_claw_migrate: run the hermes claw migrate command to preview and migrate settings from OpenClaw to Hermes
run_claw_migrate_dry_run: run hermes claw migrate --dry-run to preview migration changes without making any modifications
run_claw_cleanup: run the hermes claw cleanup command to archive leftover OpenClaw directories after migration
run_claw_cleanup_dry_run: run hermes claw cleanup --dry-run to preview which OpenClaw directories would be archived
run_claw_migrate_preset: run hermes claw migrate --preset full --overwrite to perform a full migration overwriting any conflicts
